# Kobayashi Maru - Complete Reference

> A Star Trek-themed endless tower defense game built with TypeScript, PixiJS 8, and bitECS.

Play the game: https://chayuto.github.io/kobayashi-maru/
Source code: https://github.com/chayuto/kobayashi-maru
License: MIT

## Overview

Kobayashi Maru is a free, open-source browser game where the player defends the civilian freighter Kobayashi Maru against infinite enemy waves by placing and upgrading turrets. Named after the famous no-win scenario from Star Trek, it is an endless survival tower defense game — the goal is to survive as long as possible against ever-increasing odds.

The game runs entirely in the browser with no server requirements. It uses modern web technologies including WebGPU (with WebGL fallback), procedural audio synthesis, and a high-performance entity-component-system (ECS) architecture supporting 5,000+ concurrent entities at 60 FPS.

## How to Play

1. Defend the Kobayashi Maru (center ship) from endless enemy waves
2. Click turret buttons on the right panel to select a turret type
3. Place turrets by clicking on the battlefield
4. Earn Matter (resources) by defeating enemies
5. Upgrade turrets by clicking on placed turrets for increased effectiveness
6. Survive as long as possible — the game never ends

### Controls

- Mouse: Place turrets, select for upgrades, navigate UI
- ESC: Cancel turret placement / Pause game
- Backtick (`): Toggle debug overlay
- Enter/R: Restart when game over

## Turret Types

| Turret | Cost | Damage | Fire Rate | Range | Special |
|--------|------|--------|-----------|-------|---------|
| Phaser Array | 100 | 10 | 4/sec | 200 | High fire rate |
| Torpedo Launcher | 200 | 50 | 0.5/sec | 350 | Highest damage |
| Disruptor Bank | 150 | 15 | 2/sec | 250 | Balanced stats |
| Tetryon Beam | 150 | 12 | 3/sec | 220 | 3x shield damage |
| Plasma Cannon | 180 | 8 | 1/sec | 200 | Burning DOT |
| Polaron Beam | 160 | 11 | 2.5/sec | 230 | Stacking slow |

### Upgrade Paths (5 Per Turret)

- Weapon Power: +25% / +50% / +100% damage
- Targeting Range: +20% / +40% / +80% range
- Fire Rate: +30% / +60% / +120% fire rate
- Multi-Target: 2 / 3 simultaneous targets
- Special: Turret-specific unique enhancements (3 levels)

## Enemy Factions

| Faction | Visual | Behavior |
|---------|--------|----------|
| Klingon | Red Triangle | Direct assault, aggressive approach |
| Romulan | Green Crescent | Evasive strafing movement |
| Borg | Green Square | Coordinated swarm behavior |
| Tholian | Orange Diamond | Flanking maneuvers |
| Species 8472 | Purple Y-shape | Targets turrets first (Hunter) |

### Enemy Variants

- Normal: Base stats
- Elite: 3x health, 1.5x damage, special glow effect
- Boss: 10x health, 2x damage, unique abilities (every 5 waves)

### Enemy Special Abilities

1. Teleport: Instant relocation
2. Cloak: Temporary invisibility
3. Shield Regeneration: Self-healing shields
4. Split on Death: Spawns smaller units
5. Summon Reinforcements: Calls additional enemies
6. Energy Drain: Reduces turret effectiveness
7. EMP Burst: Area-of-effect disable
8. Ramming Speed: Charges directly at target

## Game Systems

- Wave System: 10 predefined waves + infinite procedural generation
- Combo System: Kill streaks with score multipliers (up to 10x)
- Achievement System: 8 achievements with localStorage persistence
- 50 unique Star Trek story texts displayed per wave

## Technical Architecture

- Language: TypeScript (strict mode)
- Renderer: PixiJS 8 (WebGPU preferred, WebGL fallback)
- ECS: bitECS 0.4.0 for entity-component-system architecture
- Build: Vite
- Audio: Web Audio API with procedural sound generation
- Testing: Vitest (unit), Playwright (E2E)
- Performance: 60 FPS target with 5,000+ entities, spatial hashing, entity pooling

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── core/           # Game facade, managers, loop, services
├── ecs/            # Components, entity factory, world, templates
├── systems/        # 14+ ECS systems (AI, combat, damage, movement, etc.)
├── rendering/      # PixiJS sprites, beams, particles, textures
├── audio/          # AudioManager, SoundGenerator
├── ui/             # HUD, panels, overlays, menus
├── game/           # WaveManager, ScoreManager, UpgradeManager
├── config/         # Centralized configuration
├── collision/      # SpatialHash for collision detection
├── services/       # DamageService, EntityPoolService, StorageService
└── types/          # Constants, events, type definitions
```
